title: GetCourseContentsRequest
description: Get course contents by course id.

options.description:
List of optional filters to customize the returned course content.
Option names:
* excludemodules (boolean) - Do not return modules, return only the sections structure.
* excludecontents (boolean) - Do not return module contents (e.g., files inside a resource).
* includestealthmodules (boolean) - Return stealth modules for students in a special section (id -1).
* sectionid (integer) - Return only this section.
* sectionnumber (integer) - Return only this section by order number.
* cmid (integer) - Return only this module information.
* modname (string) - Return only modules with this name (e.g., label, forum, etc.).
* modid (integer) - Return only the module with this ID (used with modname).

value.description: Value for the corresponding option. Type should match expected (boolean as '0'/'1', integer as string, or module name).
